name: IC 2 with H0 = 2.5
setup: IC 2 with mean depth H0 = 2.5 (paper Fig. 12), 25% deeper than all training data (H0 = 2).
expect: Deeper water means faster waves, so the network is queried on states it never saw. The paper reports good results in this ±25% band.
observed: Works well: h error 0.22% for MCL-NN, about as good as inside the training range.
